title: TorchSpatial: A Location Encoding Framework and Benchmark for Spatial Representation Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the spatial autocorrelation of model performance across geographic regions using a novel metric called Geo-Bias Scores. This relies on Spatial Self-Information (SSI) to compute 'unmarked' scores (baseline spatial distribution of data) and 'marked' scores (spatial distribution of model prediction errors or successes), alongside hot spot analysis to visualize clusters of high and low performance.
